title: Cheat Sheet - Lua
markdown:
## Values and variables

| Write | Means |
|---|---|
| `local x = 5` | a local variable (always use local) |
| `local a, b = 1, 2` / `a, b = b, a` | several at once / swap |
| `local MAX <const> = 10` | cannot be assigned again |
| `nil`, `true`, `false` | only nil and false are false; 0 and "" are true |
| `type(v)` | "nil" "boolean" "number" "string" "table" "function" "thread" "userdata" |
| `math.type(n)` | "integer" or "float" |
| `-- comment`, `--[[ long ]]` | comments |

## Operators

| Operator | Notes |
|---|---|
| `+ - * %` | `%` takes the sign of the divisor |
| `/` | always a float |
| `//` | floor division, rounds down |
| `^` | power, always a float |
| `== ~= < > <= >=` | `~=` is "not equal" |
| `and or not` | return an operand: `x or default`, `c and a or b` |
| `..` | join strings |
| `#` | length of a string (bytes) or a list |
| `& \| ~ << >> ~` | bitwise (integers) |

## Control flow

```lua-norun
if x > 0 then ... elseif x < 0 then ... else ... end
while cond do ... end
repeat ... until cond            -- runs at least once
for i = 1, 10 do ... end         -- both ends included
for i = 10, 1, -1 do ... end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do ... end
for k, v in pairs(t) do ... end  -- no order
break
goto continue  ...  ::continue::
```

## Functions

```lua-norun
local function add(a, b) return a + b end
local f = function(x) return x * 2 end
local function stats(t) return min, max end      -- several results
local function f(a, b) b = b or 10 end           -- default
local function f(...) local n = select("#", ...) end
local args = table.pack(...)                     -- args.n
f{ name = "x" }   f"text"                        -- one table or string argument
```

## Tables

| Write | Does |
|---|---|
| `{ 1, 2, 3 }` | a list, starting at index 1 |
| `{ name = "Ada", ["key with space"] = 1 }` | a record or dictionary |
| `t.name` / `t["name"]` / `t[var]` | read a field |
| `t.x = nil` | remove a key |
| `t[#t + 1] = v` | add at the end |
| `table.insert(t, v)` / `table.insert(t, i, v)` | add at the end / at position i |
| `table.remove(t)` / `table.remove(t, i)` | remove and return the last / item i |
| `table.sort(t)` / `table.sort(t, function(a, b) return a > b end)` | sort in place |
| `table.concat(t, sep)` | join a list into a string |
| `table.unpack(t)` | the items as separate values |
| `next(t) == nil` | the table is empty |

## Strings

| Call | Gives |
|---|---|
| `s:upper()`, `s:lower()`, `s:rep(n, sep)`, `s:reverse()` | new strings |
| `s:sub(i, j)` | characters i to j; negative counts from the end |
| `s:byte(i)`, `string.char(65)` | codes and back |
| `s:find("x", 1, true)` | start, end of plain text, or nil |
| `s:match(pattern)` | the match or its captures, or nil |
| `s:gmatch(pattern)` | an iterator over matches |
| `s:gsub(pattern, repl, n)` | new string, number of replacements |
| `string.format("%5.2f %-8s %03d %q", ...)` | formatted text |
| `tostring(v)`, `tonumber(s)`, `tonumber(s, 16)` | conversions |
| `utf8.len(s)`, `utf8.char(233)`, `utf8.codes(s)`, `utf8.charpattern` | characters, not bytes |

## Patterns

| Item | Matches |
|---|---|
| `.` | any character |
| `%a %d %s %w %p %l %u %x` | letter, digit, space, alphanumeric, punctuation, lower, upper, hex (capital = not) |
| `[abc]`, `[^,]`, `[%w_]` | sets |
| `+ * - ?` | 1 or more, 0 or more, 0 or more (fewest), optional |
| `^` `$` | start, end |
| `( )` | capture |
| `%1` | the first capture (in gsub replacements) |
| `%.` `%%` `%-` | a literal `. % -` |
| `%f[%w]` | frontier: start of a word |

## Metatables and classes

```lua-norun
local Point = {}
Point.__index = Point
function Point.new(x, y) return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y }, Point) end
function Point:len() return math.sqrt(self.x ^ 2 + self.y ^ 2) end
Point.__add = function(a, b) return Point.new(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y) end
Point.__tostring = function(p) return "(" .. p.x .. ", " .. p.y .. ")" end

local Point3 = setmetatable({}, { __index = Point })   -- inherits
Point3.__index = Point3

p:len()      -- the same as p.len(p)
```

Metamethods: `__index __newindex __call __tostring __len __eq __lt __le __add __sub __mul __div __mod __pow __unm __idiv __concat __close __gc __mode`. `rawget` / `rawset` skip them.

## Modules

```lua-norun
-- shapes.lua
local M = {}
local function helper() end      -- private
function M.area(r) return math.pi * r * r end
return M

-- main.lua
local shapes = require("shapes")  -- loaded once, cached in package.loaded
```

## Errors

```lua-norun
error("message")            error("message", 2)  -- blame the caller
error({ code = 404 })       -- any value
assert(value, "message")    -- error if value is false or nil; else returns its arguments
local ok, result = pcall(f, args)
local ok, result = xpcall(f, debug.traceback, args)
return nil, "message"       -- for expected failures
```

## Coroutines

```lua-norun
local co = coroutine.create(function(a) local b = coroutine.yield(a + 1) end)
coroutine.resume(co, 1)        -- true, 2
coroutine.status(co)           -- suspended / running / normal / dead
local gen = coroutine.wrap(function() for i = 1, 3 do coroutine.yield(i) end end)
for v in gen do ... end
```

## Files and os

```lua-norun
local f = assert(io.open("x.txt", "w"))   -- "r" "w" "a" "r+", add "b" for binary
f:write("text", 42, "\n")
f:close()
local f <close> = assert(io.open("x.txt"))
f:read("l")  f:read("n")  f:read("a")
for line in io.lines("x.txt") do ... end
io.write("no newline")   io.read()   io.read("n")
os.time()  os.date("%Y-%m-%d")  os.clock()  os.getenv("HOME")  os.remove(name)
```

## Deeper Lua (milestone 7)

```lua
local env = { print = print, math = { floor = math.floor } }
local chunk = assert(load(code, "script", "t", env))   -- "t": text only, env: its globals
local co = coroutine.create(chunk)
debug.sethook(co, function() error("step limit") end, "", 100000)
print(coroutine.resume(co))

local cache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "v" })   -- values may be collected
local extra = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })   -- keys may be collected
local f <close> = setmetatable({}, { __close = function() print("closed") end })

local perms = READ | WRITE; perms = perms & ~WRITE; local set = perms & READ ~= 0
print(7 // 2, -7 // 2, 1 << 4, 0xFF ~ 0x0F)
local bytes = string.pack("<I2 s1 d", 512, "Ada", 98.5)
local id, name, score, pos = string.unpack("<I2 s1 d", bytes)
```

## Lua in practice

```lua-norun
-- queue: push  q.last = q.last + 1; q[q.last] = v
--        pop   v = q[q.first]; q[q.first] = nil; q.first = q.first + 1
set[x] = true; if set[x] then ... end
-- heap: children of i are 2*i and 2*i + 1, the parent is i // 2

local args = table.pack(...); fn(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
(s:gsub("a", "b"))                  -- brackets keep only the first result

string.format("%q", s)               -- a string as Lua source
load("return " .. text, "data", "t", {})   -- load data safely

setmetatable(Class, { __call = function(cls, ...) return cls.new(...) end })
for k, v in pairs(Mixin) do Class[k] = v end

local sin = math.sin                  -- locals in hot loops
local parts = {}; parts[#parts + 1] = piece; table.concat(parts, ",")
local t0 = os.clock(); ...; print(os.clock() - t0)
```
